summary: Admin Architecte feature fully verified. ZONES popover correctly hides 'Couches STEEVE-MAX' title and 'dominant/secondaire/tertiaire' badges in default view. Admin mode activates via shield button with password 'Saturn5858*'. When active: button turns purple, tooltip shows 'Contrôle la dominance comportementale interne', all classification labels appear. Deactivation requires no password and correctly hides labels again. ALIMENTATION-V2 regression verified: badge shows count (4), selector 1-4 works, OURS NOIR shows disabled message and hidden badge. V10 corridors (19, 11.8km) and ZONES (7 sub-elements) working.
